text:
ana: Heads-up: scheduling a rolling maintenance for satellite-apac1 next Wed 01:00-04:00 local. Trigger: repeated ingress flaps + showing up as KV cache pressure on warm starts. Scope: 5 racks across two pods. Plan: graceful cordon/drain, NIC microcode + nvml driver refresh, seed KV caches after each rack. Reserved pools untouched.

phil: Estimated impact? canary approach?

ana: typo: ana :) Expect ~5% transient shared capacity loss if serial single-rack cohorts. Canary: rack-sat-a at 01:15 (6 nodes) -> observe 15m. If stable, proceed one rack every 25m.

cheng: Ops ask: pre-seed KV/cache 30m before start and pause large batch embedding jobs 00:30-05:00. Also make a temporary route to apac-west spare pool for tail-sensitive models.

rookie-bot: Maintenance ticket created: satellite-apac1-ingress-flap-6712345678. Link: https://console.internal/maint/6712345678 (automated).

mike: Cost/backfill note: prefer intra-region spare nodes. If we must borrow 12 GPUs from apac-west for 3h ~ ~$650. Cross-region is last resort (~$1.4k). We'll only do that if p95 +200ms or error +0.4%.

ana: Runbook (ops copy):
```bash
# cordon nodes in rack
kubectl cordon node-sat-a{01..06} -n inference
kubectl drain node-sat-a{01..06} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 -n inference
# quick nvml check
ssh ops@node-sat-a01 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv,noheader"
# apply nic microcode
ssh ops@node-sat-a01 "sudo /usr/bin/apply-nic-fw && sudo reboot"
# seed KV cache after uncordon
kubectl exec -n ops job/kv-seed -- /bin/sh -c 'python /opt/seed.py --region satellite-apac1'
```

phil: Include a 12-minute human approval between canary and next rack. We had blind roll once and it caused tail spikes.

ana: Will add manual hold + automated gating: p95, error rate, retransmit counters, GPU temp delta. Also auto-notify finance if backfill spend > $1k.

cheng: Who's oncall? I can do infra-watch but need net owner for retransmit/crc checks.

mike: I'll take network. Cheng you take infra-watch, Phil ML perf. Please ACK by EOD.

phil: ACK — will prepare p50/p95/p99 and cold-start dashboards.

cheng: ACK. Ill prepare spare nodes in apac-west (12) and a rollback play for async-egress flip.

mike: ACK — will prep net rollback checklist (BGP restore, egress cap flip).

ana: Drafting tenant-facing blurb for non-reserved customers (short window + contact). If no objections well schedule canary next Wed. :white_check_mark:
